name: Kelvin-Helmholtz with a magnetic field
blurb: The shear layer threaded by a uniform field along the flow. The eddies stretch and wind up the field, and its tension resists them. In incompressible linear theory, a field above shear / sqrt(2 (1/rho_in + 1/rho_out)), 0.58 here, keeps the layer stable. The setup follows the shear-layer preset of the taranis WebGPU reduced-MHD page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html).
